subject: Re: Pickup quote 70275 Stuttgart to STR – 26 Nov
body:
Hi there,

Thanks for the request! Our all-in price for the pickup in Stuttgart and delivery to STR is 290.56 EUR. We can collect within 14 hours of the freight being ready.

The quote is valid until 22 Nov 2026 03:24 UTC. No booking is needed; our offer reference is TRK-12040.

Best,
Nordlicht Haulage
